description: Land Title Settlement Department - Hambanthota and Idiwinna Hambanthota D/S Division, Hambanthota District - Cad. Map No. 830114, (23/0118)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (No. 204 and No. 99) with detailed property information including parcel numbers, extents, owner names, addresses, and title classifications. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and title settlement processes, falling squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
